10 05-02-2026 We find, from the judgment of conviction dated 23.02.2024 passed by the learned Court of Additional District and Sessions Judge-VI-cum-Special Court (POCSO Act), Gopalganj in POCSO Case No.13 of 2022, that the appellant has been convicted under Section 376(1) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4(1) of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012, hence it is imperative to mask the identity of the respondent No.2 (victim).
